name: Música
description: Spotify or YouTube Music in Orkestri, in a card of its own: Spotify signed in with your account (Premium plays) or YouTube Music's web player behind the card, each with what plays, back, play/pause, next, a search and a list to play from; a pill in the canvas corner (also in the UI mode) opens the whole player; a terminal linked to the card controls it (play a song or playlist, pause, next, what plays). Not made or endorsed by Spotify or Google.
